description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeDetailedModel class within the OrangeHRM project. The class serves as a data transfer object (DTO) that models detailed information about an employee, using annotations to specify schema details for API documentation. It utilizes traits and interfaces to serialize entity data, extracting various employee attributes including supervisor information, job title, employment status, and division details.

classes.name: EmployeeDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class representing comprehensive employee details for API responses, integrating employee entity data and specifying properties for serialization and documentation.
